plugin.description:
Enhance Steam Game Recording by automatically adding configurable in-game events to the timeline, allowing for easy rewinding and clipping. Rewind to the moment of your death to reassure yourself that you did dodge the AOE before it went off and that the game does hate you personally with greater efficiency than ever!

Non-steam users will have to follow a setup guide located in the configuration's window Status tab to get everything working.
plugin.summary: Add various in-game events to your Steam Game Recording timeline, comes with instructions for non-steam users!

website.description: A Dalamud plugin that adds Steam Recording timeline support for FFXIV
website.readmeExcerpt:
# Steam Recording Enhanced
Steam Recording Enhanced is a Dalamud plugin that uses [Steamworks API](https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/sdk/api) to add various ingame
events as markers on the Steam Game Recording timeline.
